pages.title: ATLAS v3.2 – Rollback Procedure
pages.content: Project Atlas — Rollback Procedure Version: v3.2 — May 2026 Release | DB Migration: Yes When to Rollback Error rate exceeds threshold within 15 minutes of deployment P1 incident raised and confirmed as deployment-related On-call engineer and release manager agree rollback is needed Rollback Steps Notify stakeholders via incident channel Raise ServiceNow incident linked to ATLAS Change Request Revert deployment to previous stable version Run DB rollback script (migration reverse) Verify application is operational on previous version Run smoke tests to confirm stability Update ServiceNow CR with rollback outcome Schedule post-incident review within 48 hours Contacts Role Action Release Manager Approves rollback decision On-Call Engineer Executes rollback steps CAB Representative Updates ServiceNow CR QA Lead Verifies rollback smoke tests
